tieu_de: Team Lead - Senior Backend Dev Backbase
dia_chi_raw: Tầng 10, Tháp A, tòa nhà CMC Creative Space, Lô Vb.27b-28-29, Đường 19, Khu Chế xuất Tân Thuận, P. Tân Thuận Đông
mo_ta_cong_viec:
Design, develop, and optimize backend services, integration components, and APIs on or around the Backbase platform, ensuring security, scalability, maintainability, and delivery quality.
Translate business requirements into technical designs, API contracts, data mappings, integration flows, estimates, and implementation plans.
Integrate Backbase with Core Banking, Payment Hub, CRM, eKYC, LOS, IAM, Data Platform, and other banking systems through REST/SOAP APIs, event-driven architecture, message queues, or middleware.
Participate in architecture, code, and design reviews; enforce coding standards and ensure quality through unit tests, integration tests, static analysis, and defect prevention.
Diagnose and resolve integration, performance, security, and production issues; conduct root-cause analysis and implement preventive actions.
Collaborate with DevOps, QA, BA, Solution Architect, and client teams to improve CI/CD pipelines, release readiness, observability, and deployment reliability.
Produce and maintain technical artifacts, including solution design, API specifications, sequence diagrams, data-mapping documents, deployment guides, and operational runbooks.
For Tech Lead level: lead a backend workstream of 4–8 engineers; plan and prioritize work, review critical pull requests, manage technical risks, mentor team members, and deliver agreed milestones.
yeu_cau:
5 years of proven experience in backend software development, including enterprise-scale systems and complex system integrations.
Demonstrable experience delivering, customizing, upgrading, or integrating Backbase in at least one digital-banking project; familiarity with Backbase Engagement Banking Platform, Digital Banking Services, or Backbase Integration is highly valued.
Strong hands-on experience with Java 11+, Spring Boot, Spring Security, RESTful API design, JSON/XML, Maven or Gradle.
Solid understanding of microservices architecture, API lifecycle management, versioning, authentication and authorization, idempotency, error handling, and observability.
Experience integrating enterprise systems using REST/SOAP, Kafka or equivalent messaging technologies.
Strong database experience with Oracle, PostgreSQL, or MySQL, including SQL analysis, query optimization, and data modeling for integration workloads.
Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes/OpenShift, Git, Jenkins/GitLab CI, and CI/CD practices.
Backbase certification is required
Strong communication and interpersonal skills in English; able to read and write technical documentation and participate effectively in technical discussions with international stakeholders.
